limits: Search is bounded, not a full backlink index or census.
No user identities, paying customers, package install counts or independent operators inferred from catalog presence.
Two HTTP403 responses and web cache misses are access limits, not absence.
Guessed /ai-market/v2/manifest and /docs/methodology 404 are not broken advertised links; advertised routes were followed and 200.
Initial sandbox DNS failures were an execution-environment restriction; final GETs use permitted network access.
